Context Window

You might say

The AI forgets what I said at the start of a long chat. Does it have a memory limit?

The total amount of input and output a model can process in one request·After a long chat, “follow the first requirement” can fail if that requirement was not included in the current request. More context capacity does not make every piece of information relevant.

It still fits, with room reserved for the model’s answer.
How context window space is allocated

Shared space: System prompts, conversation history, files, and response space all share the same total context window limit.

Output truncation is separate: Input context and max output tokens are separate (output truncation is usually due to reaching the output limit, not necessarily a full window).

Bigger isn't always better: A larger window doesn't mean you can cram everything in—irrelevant material dilutes the AI's attention and causes it to drift.

What people often confuse

A larger window does not mean you should include every file. Irrelevant material can bury the point.
